task.name: Phase 4: OpenClaw Integration
task.description: Create thin skill wrapper and verify file descriptor stability
task.action:
1. Create skill directory: mkdir -p ~/.openclaw/skills/google-ads-pro
2. Create skill.md wrapper: # Markdown file that documents CLI usage # NO Python code, NO venv/, just documentation # Contains: - Skill purpose - Available commands with examples - Usage patterns for Claude - References to google-ads-cli binary
3. Verify file count: find ~/.openclaw/skills/google-ads-pro -type f | wc -l # MUST be exactly 1 (just skill.md)
4. Check file descriptors BEFORE skill use: lsof -p $(pgrep openclaw-gateway) | wc -l # Should be ~56
5. Restart gateway to detect new skill: launchctl stop ai.openclaw.gateway sleep 2 launchctl start ai.openclaw.gateway sleep 5
6. Check file descriptors AFTER restart: lsof -p $(pgrep openclaw-gateway) | wc -l # Should STILL be ~56 (no increase)
task.verify: - Only 1 file exists in ~/.openclaw/skills/google-ads-pro/ - skill.md is markdown only (no code) - No venv/, no __pycache__, no .py files - File descriptors remain at ~56 - Gateway successfully restarted - Gateway logs show skill detected
task.done: - Skill wrapper created - File count: 15,923 → 1 (99.99% reduction) - File descriptors stable - Gateway healthy - Ready for testing
